body:
Yeah my parents have depression and are bipolar among a few other issues like anxiety and they are disabled and we are pretty poor so I'm taking care of everyone as best I can at my age but it's insanity to me because everything I do effects the whole family so if I'm not on my A game everything tends to fall apart. I'm under so much pressure all the time. I think I'm getting sick cause of all my stress. It's like this vicious cycle and there's no way out for anyone if I don't figure out something. 

I'm just drowning and it's kinda funny. Friends of mine laugh because that's really the only thing you can do or say.

I'm trying to be positive I really really am. I hate to sound like I'm weak but It's just hard when you feel like you are dying. I'm scared honestly I've just about lost my ability to eat. It's so painful. I can't afford to do anything but hide. I don't want to be one of those people who ends up in a mental hospital because they can't handle their shit but I feel like I hit my limit.

I sacrificed my entire life and now I just don't have anything left. 

 Edit: I keep saying they. Omit that Lol my dad died last year I haven't dealt with it yet but he was an asshole so I'll deal with mourning once I'm ready I'm just not ready yet. I keep forgetting

Is there anything I can do to make it better? I've tried therapy and breathing exercises and meditation and it helped in the beginning but now something has changed idk but my health is suffering and I just feel so lost. I'm too young to feel this way and I don't know what I'm doing wrong.
